purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 372 Xining (city code 3826); source registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: 西宁市不动产登记局 / Xining Real Estate Registration Bureau
registryBasis: The Xining Real Estate Registration Bureau operates an official local registration portal, xnsbdc.cn, with registration, certificate, archive-verification and transaction services. This confirms a city-local property registry; no public anonymous parcel geometry service was identified.

officialSources.observation: Official Xining Real Estate Registration Bureau portal lists transaction progress, certificate query, online acceptance and archive verification and names the city bureau as publisher.
Official portal lists city registration service guides, including real-estate registration information query; no public parcel geometry service is described on this index page.
Xining municipal spatial plan PDF identifies the Xining Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau; its maps are planning/regional maps, not parcel geometry.

searchQueries.query: Xining China official real estate registry cadastral map parcel GIS public map natural resources
searchQueries.scope: Find a city-specific official cadastral registry and anonymous full parcel map service.
searchQueries.result: The search surfaced Xining government land-use planning map material and an official Xining real-estate registration portal. The portal describes registration and online service functions; no anonymous citywide parcel feature service was found in the reviewed official pages.
searchQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search followed by direct inspection of the Xining registration portal.

searchQueries.query: 西宁市 不动产登记 地籍图 查询 地图 西宁市不动产登记服务中心
searchQueries.scope: 查找西宁市本地不动产登记机构及公众可用的宗地地图/地籍图服务。
searchQueries.result: 找到西宁市不动产登记局/服务中心官方门户，列出登记、证书查询、查档核验及网上受理。公开页面没有证实匿名全市宗地矢量服务，也没有取得完整宗地几何。
searchQueries.executionMethod: 简体中文检索并直接查看官方西宁市不动产登记门户页面。

accessReview.reason: The official portal publicly documents real-estate registration and lookup workflows but the reviewed public pages do not expose a citywide parcel layer or anonymous full polygon query. The published service menu is transaction-oriented. No login, identity verification, address lookup, or property-specific query was attempted.

requestEvidence.observation: Searches were conducted separately in English and the city/country primary language. Search results and official source pages are recorded above; search-result presence is not treated as a parcel response.
Inspected the listed official HTML/content sources only. No undocumented endpoint or feature response was observed, so no HTTP status, feature count, CRS or native feature ID is asserted.
Public homepage directly fetched; HTML has no terms for map, cadastral, parcel, WFS or GeoServer.
Public service-guide index directly fetched; no map/cadastral terms or map link surfaced.
Anonymous business-handling route redirects to login. No login or record-specific lookup attempted.
Public query-guide page title loaded, but body content is a linked image; image endpoint was not fetched.

technicalBlocker: Direct anonymous GETs confirm the public Xining registration portal loads, but its homepage and service-guide index contain no publicly advertised cadastral-map/vector route. The business-handling service path returns HTTP 302 to `/userlogin`. No anonymous full parcel geometry endpoint was found; no sign-in or property-specific query was attempted.
sampleDisposition: No public anonymous map geometry route verified. The public business-handling route redirects to login; zero polygons retained.
remainingUncertainty: A local map layer may exist behind the portal or in a separate Qinghai/Xining mapping service. The public HTML and linked static site assets inspected do not establish its route or access conditions.

staticScriptInspection.method: Anonymous GET of each unique script src referenced by https://www.xnsbdc.cn/index; no login or property-specific action.
staticScriptInspection.result: All 12 returned HTTP 200. No site-specific public map/cadastre/parcel/schema endpoint was found. Generic “map” text occurred only in shared libraries; site-specific /basicindex had no map/cadastre/parcel/WFS/WMS/GeoJSON terms.
